primeros-pasos.title: Getting started with Ocean Flow
primeros-pasos.summary: A quick tour of the three main screens before you log your first entry.
primeros-pasos.whatYouCanDo: Ocean Flow helps you keep track of your income as a freelance instructor: the classes you teach, the commissions you earn from referred clients, and the money adjustments with other instructors — all under one concept, "entry".
primeros-pasos.whenToUseIt: The first time you open the app, or whenever you want a reminder of what each screen is for.

steps.text: Home: how much you have pending to collect, a widget with your oldest debts, the month's calendar, and a shortcut to create an entry.
steps.imageAlt: Home screen with the total pending to collect and the month's calendar

steps: My work: the full list of your entries (courses, commissions and adjustments) — create, edit, collect or delete them.
Summary: your balance for whichever period you pick, with the option to drill down by school, by course, or by commissions.
tips: The natural order for a new account is: 1) Set up your app (schools, courses, rates), 2) Log one entry of each type you use, 3) Collect — one at a time as you get paid, or all at once if you check in periodically. Each of these three steps has its own guide in "I want to..." below.
primeros-pasos.expectedResult: You know which screen to use for each situation, and in what order, so the app is ready for your day-to-day.

configurar-app.title: Set up your app
configurar-app.summary: Nothing is fixed in the app: schools, courses, rates and payment catalogues are all edited from Settings.
configurar-app.whatYouCanDo: Settings is organised into two blocks: what any user maintains (Schools, Courses, Rates) and, if you have an admin role, an "Administration" block with catalogues for the whole app (payment types and statuses, currencies, colours, users).
configurar-app.whenToUseIt: Before logging your first entry, and afterwards every time you start working with a new school or course, or change a price.

steps.text: Go to Settings (gear icon, top right) and tap the section you need.
steps.imageAlt: Settings menu with the Schools, Courses and Rates sections

steps: Add your Schools and Courses first — a Rate always links a school to a course, so both need to exist beforehand.
Inside a section, tap the floating "+" button to create one; "‹ Settings" takes you back to the menu.
Tap a row's colour to customise it, and the star to mark it as a favourite.
tips: A school, course or currency marked as a favourite comes preselected in creation forms.
Closing Settings (the "✕" in the header) always takes you back to the tab you came in from.
configurar-app.expectedResult: The new school, course or rate is available right away when you create an entry — with this done, you're ready to move on to "Log an entry".

crear-movimiento.title: Create an entry
crear-movimiento.summary: The same form covers a course taught, a commission, or an adjustment with a colleague — each type has its own fields.
crear-movimiento.whatYouCanDo: "Add entry" is the only creation entry point in the whole app — the form itself lets you pick the type, no need to find a different button for each case.
crear-movimiento.whenToUseIt: Right after teaching a class, when closing a commission, or when you agree an adjustment with another instructor.
steps: Tap "Add entry": the "+" button on the "Pending to collect" card in Home, the same button by tapping a day on Home's calendar, or the floating "+" in My work.

steps.text: At the top of the form, choose the type: Course taught, Commission, or Course adjustment.
steps.imageAlt: Entry creation sheet with the type selector: Course taught, Commission or Course adjustment

steps: Course taught: school, course, date and number of people — the course rate calculates the amount for you.
Commission: same as a course, but for a client you referred who trains with another instructor — it uses its own commission rate, not the course one.
Course adjustment: doesn't depend on any rate — you enter the amount yourself (positive if you're owed, negative if you owe) and which colleague it's with.
Save. If you opened the form from Home, you'll see the entry in My work right after saving.
tips: If there isn't a rate yet for that school + course, the form lets you create one on the fly without leaving the screen ("Add rate") — this only applies to Course and Commission, an Adjustment never needs a rate.
Cancelling or closing the form without saving creates nothing — you can open and close it freely without worrying about leaving half-finished entries.
crear-movimiento.expectedResult: The entry shows up in My work, under "Pending", and gets added to "Earned this month" on Home (except for an adjustment against you, which doesn't count as earned).

cobrar-movimientos.title: Mark entries as collected
cobrar-movimientos.summary: Keep track of what you have pending to collect and update the status as soon as you get paid — one at a time, or all at once.
cobrar-movimientos.whatYouCanDo: Every entry has a status (pending or collected). Changing it is instant, a single tap, with the option to undo if you make a mistake. You can do it entry by entry, or all at once across the whole visible list.
cobrar-movimientos.whenToUseIt: As soon as a school or a colleague pays you (one at a time), or all at once when you check in periodically and several payments have already come through.

steps.text: To collect one: go to My work (the "Pending" tab opens by default) and tap "Confirm payment" on its row (or "Mark settled" if it's an adjustment against you).
steps.imageAlt: List of pending entries in My work with the Confirm payment button

steps: The "Pending to collect" card on Home takes you straight to that same tab — one tap from the main screen.
To collect several at once: in My work, use "Collect all" above the list — it affects everything currently visible.
Before "Collect all", use "Filter" (by date, school, course or type) to narrow the list down to exactly what you want to collect in one go.
tips: A toast with "Undo" appears after every change — you have a few seconds to revert it without having to find the entry again.
"Collect all" asks for confirmation before applying — there's no "Undo" for the whole batch, unlike collecting one at a time.
cobrar-movimientos.expectedResult: The entry (or all the filtered ones) moves to the "Collected" tab and its amount stops counting toward "Pending to collect" on Home.

consultar-generado.title: Check how much you've earned
consultar-generado.summary: A quick glance on Home, or the full detail for whichever period you choose in Summary.
consultar-generado.whatYouCanDo: "Earned this month" on Home gives you the current month's figure, with a hint of whether you're doing better or worse than last month, without leaving the main screen. Tapping it takes you straight to Summary, which goes further: any period, compared with the previous one, with the option to drill down by school or by course.
consultar-generado.whenToUseIt: Home, for a quick glance when you open the app. Summary, when you want a period other than the current month or want to understand where the money is coming from.
steps: On Home, the "Earned this month" card is always visible, no need to tap anything — and tapping it takes you to Summary to dig deeper.

steps.text: In Summary, choose the granularity and period in the control at the top (monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, yearly, or a custom range) and, if you want, the type (Course, Commission or Adjustment).
steps.imageAlt: Summary screen with the monthly trend strip and the period total

steps: The main card shows the period's total and how much it's changed compared with the previous period.
Tap "By school", "By course", "Commissions", "Course adjustments" or "Calendar" to drill down — each one only expands when you ask for it.
tips: Inside "By school", tap a school to see its breakdown by course right there, without leaving the card.
The comparison with the previous period doesn't show up if you mix more than one currency in the same period — this avoids showing a calculation that wouldn't be accurate.
consultar-generado.expectedResult: You have a balance figure for the period you chose, with the detail of where each bit of income comes from if you need it.

mi-trabajo-referencia.title: My work, at a glance
mi-trabajo-referencia.summary: The full list of your entries — courses, commissions and adjustments — with their actions.
mi-trabajo-referencia.whatYouCanDo: My work unifies what used to be three separate screens (Log, Commissions and Colleagues) into a single place, grouped by collection status.
mi-trabajo-referencia.whenToUseIt: This is your day-to-day work screen — create, review, collect and edit entries.
steps: Pending / Collected: the two tabs at the top, with the pending total on the card above them.
"Filter": narrows the list by period, school, course or entry type.
On each row: "Confirm payment"/"Mark pending" to change the status, and the "⋯" menu for Edit or Delete.
The floating "+" button opens the same creation form as the rest of the app.
tips: "Collect all"/"Mark all pending" act on the visible list — with filters active, they only affect what's filtered.
Deleting asks for confirmation and animates the row leaving, so you see exactly what you've deleted.
mi-trabajo-referencia.expectedResult: You can find and update any entry without leaving this screen.

resumen-referencia.title: Summary, at a glance
resumen-referencia.summary: One headline total at the top; everything else only expands if you ask for it.
resumen-referencia.whatYouCanDo: Summary combines a quick answer (the period's total, compared with the previous one) with collapsible cards for anyone who wants to dig deeper.
resumen-referencia.whenToUseIt: To understand how a period is going, compare schools or courses, or review commissions and adjustments with colleagues.
steps: Choose a granularity (monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, yearly or custom); the period strip below scrolls on its own — tap any period to re-centre on it.
Filter by type (Total, Course, Commission or Adjustment) with the segmented control below.
The main card shows the total and, when it makes sense to calculate it, the comparison with the previous period.
Tap any card (By school, By course, Commissions, Course adjustments, Calendar) to expand it.
tips: With more than one school, "By school" starts expanded, since it's the most common question after the total; with just one school, that card doesn't appear at all (there'd be nothing to compare), and "By course" starts expanded instead. The rest always start collapsed.
Inside "By school", tap a school to see its breakdown by course without leaving the card.
resumen-referencia.expectedResult: You get the figure you were looking for, with as much or as little detail as you asked for.

configuracion-referencia.title: Settings, at a glance
configuracion-referencia.summary: The menu where you maintain your own base data: schools, courses and rates.
configuracion-referencia.whatYouCanDo: Schools, Courses and Rates — the catalogues you use when logging an entry in My work.
configuracion-referencia.whenToUseIt: To keep your base data up to date: adding a new school, a new course, or adjusting a rate.
steps: Tap any row in the menu to enter that section; "‹ Settings" takes you back to the menu.
Schools and Courses are created with the floating "+" button, same as in My work.
Rates shows Course and Commission in a single list (the type is chosen as a filter, or when creating one, right inside the sheet) — same visual pattern as My work.
configuracion-referencia.expectedResult: You can find any catalogue or setting without having to remember which tab it used to live in.

perfil-referencia.title: My profile, at a glance
perfil-referencia.summary: Your avatar, your details, your favourite currency and your password — all in one place, reachable from your name in the header.
perfil-referencia.whatYouCanDo: Tap your avatar or your nickname, top right on any screen, to go into My profile: change your avatar (icon and colour), edit your first name/last name/nickname, choose your favourite currency, change your password, and delete your account if you ever need to.
perfil-referencia.whenToUseIt: Whenever you want to personalise your account, fix a detail, or change your password without having to sign out and go through "forgot my password".
steps: Tap the avatar/nickname in the header to go into My profile.
The pencil over the avatar opens the icon and colour picker — the change saves as soon as you pick it, no separate "Save" button.
"Edit" in Personal details opens first name, last name and nickname; the nickname can't contain "@" or match another account's.
Favourite currency is used as a fallback in Course adjustment when there's no rate to determine it — every other entry always uses its own rate's currency.
tips: Changing your password here doesn't ask for your current one — since you're already inside the app, the active session is considered enough.
Deleting your account is permanent and erases all your data — to confirm it you have to type the word CANCEL, so nothing gets deleted by an accidental tap.
perfil-referencia.expectedResult: Your account reflects the avatar, details and currency you choose, and you can change your password whenever you want without leaving the app.

filtros-referencia.title: Filter and search
filtros-referencia.summary: My work, Rates and the Settings catalogues all share the same filter pattern.
filtros-referencia.whatYouCanDo: A "Filter" button (showing the number of active filters) expands a panel with the fields available — period, school, course, type... — instead of always showing them above the list.
filtros-referencia.whenToUseIt: When the list has too many items to review them all at a glance.
steps: Tap "Filter" to expand the panel of fields available on that screen.
Choose one or several — the course filter supports multiple selection.
"Clear filters" appears as soon as at least one is active.
tips: The catalogue search (Courses, Currencies) filters as you type, ignoring case and accents.
filtros-referencia.expectedResult: The list shows only what you're interested in, without losing sight of how many filters you have active.
